authorization: Owner requested proceeding with the review revisions and biological rationale; commit amendments before new scoring.

question.hypothesis: Lesion-associated epithelial programmes add to a shared plasticity component.
question.test: Does the frozen lesion-specific module rise in lung adenocarcinoma epithelium relative to the same patient's normal type 2 cells, in a cohort never scored with it?

discovery.role: discovery only; already scored and reported, so it cannot also evaluate
discovery.module_identity: lesion_specific is gene-for-gene identical to HPCS_without_ADI_or_operational_markers, scored by the completed human run
discovery.configuration: unc20_pooled, label __broad__ (the broad type 2 compartment), cell floor 50, LUAD minus normal
discovery.why_this_label: It is the discovery run's own primary: its validation record counts primary_broad_contrasts, and its report and the register quote this figure. It is also the closer analogue of Kim's pooled tumour epithelium.
discovery.correction: The version committed in e6b9dc9 cited the narrower AT2 label as the discovery reference. It was corrected to the discovery primary before any Kim score existed; only eligibility, from gene names and cell labels, had run. The Kim populations, test and decision rules are unchanged.

cohort.pairing_evidence: the deposit's Feature Summary patient id column, not sample-name resemblance
cohort.prior_use: opened once, for trial E1 on EGFR ligand RNA; never scored with any module in this plan

lesion_arm.pooling: all three pooled; no subtype selected

populations.difference_from_discovery: Changed population contrast: all author tumour epithelial subtypes versus normal AT2, rather than atlas-mapped type-2-like cells in both arms. Neither necessarily stricter nor identical population transport.
populations.malignancy: The author annotation has no copy-number malignancy label, so the lesion arm may include non-malignant epithelium.

eligibility.cell_floor_origin: inherited from the discovery primary configuration, not chosen for this cohort
eligibility.gate1_statistic: assayed source fraction: strict one-to-one ortholog, then presence in the Kim gene index, over the module's mouse length
eligibility.on_gate_failure: a module failing gate 1 is not scored; if the primary fails, the test is not run and the result is recorded as ineligible

scoring.instrument: the discovery run's own procedure in Research Article/gate2_C3_yu_lee_choi_min_2026/trials/u5_human_paired_pathways.R
scoring.pseudobulk: sum raw UMI over the arm's cells for each patient
scoring.normalization: edgeR calcNormFactors method TMM across all eligible pseudobulks together, then cpm with log TRUE and prior.count 1
scoring.module_score: mean logCPM over the module's genes present in the gene index
scoring.difference: lesion arm score minus normal arm score, per patient
scoring.instrument_check: Before any Kim score, the same code must reproduce the discovery's tracked per-patient differences for this module from the cached discovery pseudobulks, within 1e-6, for both the broad and the narrower type 2 labels. If it cannot, Kim is not scored and the discrepancy is reported.
scoring.discovery_normalization_scope: All retained patient/histology pseudobulks within comp AT2, label and floor 50, before selecting LUAD-normal paired differences.

primary.estimand: Location shift / pseudomedian of within-patient differences, lesion epithelium minus normal type 2
primary.estimate: Hodges-Lehmann with exact 95 percent confidence interval

decision_rules.interpretation: Direction and magnitude are separate axes. Upper CI below 0.10 rules out that positive margin; it is not equivalence to zero.

primary.assumptions: Independent patients; symmetric distribution of paired differences for signed-rank location inference
primary.exact_failure: No confirmatory approximate fallback when ties/zeros or interval failure prevent exact inference; preserve effects and report unavailable.
primary.margin_rationale: Pragmatic planning margin based on a fraction of discovery, not clinically validated.

secondary.family: Benjamini-Hochberg across the three tests below, q below 0.05, same test as primary

tests.name: beyond_shared
tests.estimand: per-patient lesion_specific difference minus shared_remodelling difference
tests.interpretation: Relative score activation only, not conditional adjustment, independent mechanism, or neoplasia specificity.

tests.name: stress_excluded
tests.definition: lesion_specific minus every gene in the three frozen mouse Hallmark control sets
tests.interpretation: Sensitivity to membership in the three frozen Hallmarks, not elimination of every stress or cycling response.

secondary.missing_test_rule: Unavailable or ineligible test p=1 in the fixed family, and marked unavailable.

descriptive_only: type 1 and type 2 identity axis differences
leave-one-patient-out range of the primary mean
the primary excluding the double-primary patient P0028

power.source: tables/power.tsv from scripts/00_power_calculation.py; the first version is kept under tables/superseded_power_label_AT2/
power.consequence: A null result is inconclusive unless the precise-absence rule is met, which is unlikely with this many patients.

prohibited_readings: An unresolved direction is not refutation.
The margin is not equivalence to zero.
Tumour epithelium is not confirmed malignant.
Pairing does not remove tissue composition or effect modification.
A positive primary alone establishes association, not addition or cancer specificity.
order: commit amended contract, plan and biological rationale
reproduce discovery broad and narrow paired differences within 1e-6
verify prior gates and hash-identified raw inputs
score Kim once and report all planned results

claim_hierarchy.primary_positive: Replicated lesion-associated expression in the specified population contrast
claim_hierarchy.stronger_narrow_claim: Positive primary plus positive BH-significant beyond_shared and stress_excluded: relative activation above the nominated shared score surviving specified exclusions
claim_hierarchy.not_tested: Specificity relative to non-neoplastic repair/fibrosis; malignant identity; causal mechanism; fate

amendment.historical_gates: tables/gates_run.json hashes v1 at the original gate date; do not overwrite it to match this amended file.
